mapper.sql: and d.dept_id in ( select dept_id from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors) )

select h.history_id as rowId, 'sensor' as detailType, h.create_time as recordTime, null as syncTime, d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, f.fire_point_id as firePointId, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, coalesce(h.sensor_code, s.sensor_code) as deviceCode, coalesce(g.imei, s.gateway_code, cast(g.external_tbox_id as char)) as gatewayCode, g.imei as gatewayImei, h.pressure, h.temperature, h.battery_level as batteryLevel, h.signal_strength as signalStrength, cast(h.status as char) as status, case when h.pressure is null then 'missing' when h.pressure < 0 or h.pressure > 2000 then 'dirty_pressure' else 'valid' end as dataQuality, null as longitude, null as latitude from fe_sensor_history h join fe_sensor s on h.sensor_id = s.sensor_id left join fe_gateway g on s.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id

select h.history_id as rowId, 'gateway' as detailType, h.gps_time as recordTime, h.sync_time as syncTime, d.dept_id as deptId, d.dept_name as deptName, f.fire_point_id as firePointId, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, cast(coalesce(h.external_tbox_id, g.external_tbox_id) as char) as deviceCode, cast(coalesce(h.external_tbox_id, g.external_tbox_id) as char) as gatewayCode, g.imei as gatewayImei, null as pressure, null as temperature, null as batteryLevel, null as signalStrength, null as status, 'valid' as dataQuality, h.gps_longitude as longitude, h.gps_latitude as latitude from fe_gateway_gps_history h join fe_gateway g on h.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id join sys_dept d on h.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: order by recordTime desc, rowId desc
order by recordTime desc, rowId desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(1)
from fe_gateway_gps_history h join fe_gateway g on h.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id join sys_dept d on h.dept_id = d.dept_id
from fe_sensor_history h join fe_sensor s on h.sensor_id = s.sensor_id left join fe_gateway g on s.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id

select f.fire_point_id as firePointId, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, d.dept_name as deptName from fe_fire_point f join sys_dept d on f.dept_id = d.dept_id where (f.del_flag is null or f.del_flag = '0')
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, f.sort_order, f.fire_point_id

choose.when:
select g.gateway_id as deviceId, cast(coalesce(g.external_tbox_id, g.gateway_id) as char) as deviceCode, g.imei as secondaryCode, f.fire_point_id as firePointId, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, d.dept_name as deptName from fe_gateway g left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id join sys_dept d on g.dept_id = d.dept_id where (g.del_flag is null or g.del_flag = '0')
and f.fire_point_id = #{firePointId}
and (cast(g.external_tbox_id as char) like concat('%', #{deviceKeyword}, '%') or g.imei like concat('%', #{deviceKeyword}, '%'))
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, g.external_tbox_id, g.gateway_id limit 50
choose.otherwise:
select s.sensor_id as deviceId, s.sensor_code as deviceCode, coalesce(g.imei, s.gateway_code, cast(g.external_tbox_id as char)) as secondaryCode, f.fire_point_id as firePointId, f.fire_point_name as firePointName, d.dept_name as deptName from fe_sensor s left join fe_gateway g on s.gateway_id = g.gateway_id left join fe_fire_point f on g.fire_point_id = f.fire_point_id join sys_dept d on s.dept_id = d.dept_id where (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag = '0')
and f.fire_point_id = #{firePointId}
and (s.sensor_code like concat('%', #{deviceKeyword}, '%') or s.gateway_code like concat('%', #{deviceKeyword}, '%') or g.imei like concat('%', #{deviceKeyword}, '%') or cast(g.external_tbox_id as char) like concat('%', #{deviceKeyword}, '%'))
${params.dataScope} order by d.dept_name, s.sensor_code, s.sensor_id limit 50
